edition.authority: Urban VIII, by the brief Si quid est, printed in the book after Quo primum and Cum sanctissimum and dated at S. Maria Maggiore 2 September 1634; it names Pius V and Clement VIII as the predecessors whose recognition it revises and entrusts the corrected Missal to Andrea Brogiotto, prefect of the Apostolic press.
edition.publication: Romae: Ex Typographia Vaticana, MDCXXXV (title and colophon); De licentia Superiorum. Google Books XNC4a07qPqQC, an original copy with manuscript ownership inscription Balth. Moreti; holding library not identified.

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The Roman Rite altar book containing the Order of Mass, the temporal and sanctoral cycles, Commons, votive and Requiem Masses, and related rubrical and ritual material. Edition records distinguish the authoritative typical edition from publisher-produced editions made according to it.
